question: What is the average overall rating of the players born before the year 1986?
evidence: average overall rating = DIVIDE(SUM(overall_rating), COUNT(id)); born before the year 1986 refers to strftime('%Y', birthday) < '1986';
clarification: Count each distinct id only once.
gold: SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) / COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTRING(t1.birthday, 1, 4) < '1986'
gold0: SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) / COUNT(t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(t1.birthday, 1, 4) < '1986'

d.request: What is the average overall rating of the players born before the year 1986, computed as the sum of overall_rating divided by the count of players, where each distinct player id is counted only once?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(pa.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) < 1986

b.request: What is the average overall rating across Player_Attributes records, counting each distinct record id only once, for players born before the year 1986?
b.sql: SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id IN (SELECT pa.id FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) < 1986)
b.raw: What is the average overall rating across Player_Attributes records, counting each distinct record id only once, for players born before the year 1986?

c.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(pa.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.id) AS avg_overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986'
